subject: Renewal discussion: EchoHealth retainer uplift & 12-month price cadence
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@echohealth.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@echohealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-13T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal discussion: EchoHealth retainer uplift & 12-month price cadence

Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our notes, EchoHealth is looking to increase committed monthly retainer capacity by ~40% for the next 12 months to support the new triage workflow you’re launching in Q1. We want to put a simple renewal framework on the table so your engineering and procurement teams can plan capacity without surprises.

High level proposal (quick bullets):
- Commit uplift: +40% baseline retainer (term: 12 months)
- Temporary onboarding credit: one-time $8k credit to offset migration/testing spikes
- Pricing cadence: hold current per-token price for 12 months from amendment signature, then move to agreed tier bands (step ladder) thereafter
- True-up: quarterly usage true-ups with carry-forward credits (no retroactive invoice surprises)

I’m attaching a recent extract of your Q4 usage to ground numbers (EchoHealth_Q4_usage.csv).

If you can confirm procurement timeline / PO cadence we’ll prepare an amendment and a short SOW for the uplift. If procurement needs a longer price hold (e.g., 18 months) let me know — we can route that to RevOps + Legal but want to be transparent about the levers (larger upfront commit / longer minimum term).

Next steps from our side: I’ll draft a concise amendment and share for review by EOD tomorrow. Can you please share the procurement contact and preferred billing cadence?

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Date: 2026-12-13T11:08:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: EchoHealth retainer uplift & 12-month price cadence

Michael —

Appreciate the clear summary. EchoHealth is aligned on the direction: the product team wants the +40% retainer in place Jan 1 to cover the triage rollout. A couple of asks from procurement/product: 

1) Can Redwood hold current per-token price for 12 months after signature? Procurement typically wants a 12-month stability window.
2) Can we get a one-time onboarding credit applied to the first invoice instead of a separate credit memo? That helps our accounting.
3) We may need a short SOW describing the expected burst behavior during the migration window (estimated delta attached).

I’ve looped in procurement@echohealth.com. Procurement prefers Net45 and sends POs through our vendor portal — contact there is Priya (cc’d). If you can send the amendment and a single-line SOW, Priya will route for signatures and PO.

Samir
VP Product, EchoHealth
samir@echohealth.com

Team —

Looping you in. EchoHealth wants +40% retainer with a 12-month price hold and Net45 PO flow. Procurement (Priya) will need the amendment and a single-line SOW. Quick thoughts on what we can offer without opening up the concession bank:

- Option A (light): 10% discount on incremental uplift for the first 3 billing cycles + $8k onboarding credit applied to first invoice. Maintain 12-month price hold. Quarterly true-up, carry-forward credits.
- Option B (balanced): 7% discount on baseline + incremental 8% on uplift, larger onboarding credit ($12k) but require 15-month minimum term.

Recommend pushing Option A initially — keeps term at 12 months and gives procurement the price stability they asked for. Marissa, can you draft the amendment (short — one page) and the SOW line item? Jordan, I’ll need a quick confirmation from RevOps on Net45 PO handling for this account and whether we can apply the onboarding credit as a one-line debit on the invoice.

If procurement pushes for 18 months price hold we should ask for an increased commit or a modest up-front payment.

Thanks —
Michael

Date: 2026-12-14T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal discussion: EchoHealth retainer uplift & 12-month price cadence

Samir / Priya —

Thanks for the quick turn. We reviewed internally and are comfortable with the 12-month price hold paired with a modest onboarding credit. Below is the succinct amendment we’re proposing (summary):

- Commit: +40% baseline retainer for a 12-month amendment (effective on signature)
- Pricing: current per-token rates held for 12 months from signature date
- Discount: 10% off incremental uplift volume for first 3 billing cycles
- Onboarding credit: $8,000 applied as a line-item credit on first invoice
- True-up: quarterly reconciliation; unused credits carry forward for up to 2 quarters
- Billing terms: Net45 (EchoHealth PO required)

We’ve uploaded a redline and clean amendment and a single-line SOW to the deal in HubSpot for Priya to review. DocuSign link below for your convenience — the amendment is intentionally short so procurement can approve quickly. If Priya wants the onboarding credit as a separate credit memo instead of an invoice line, we can accommodate that preference as well.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5342/DH-3409

Please confirm and I’ll kick off DocuSign + Ops once we get the PO number. Happy to hop on a 15-minute call if you’d prefer to walk the SOW.

Best —
Michael Grant
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
